fair dinkum is kind of hard to explain. But I'll take a crack at it.

First off fair dinkum is not any of the things you've cited in the OP. Fair Dinkum is used to describe something that is honest or fair. For example, when a fruit seller or someone of the sort is marketing his or her product as having a fair dinkum price, it means that they have priced it at a point where they make a reasonable income and you still get something that is high quality but still priced to be affordable.

It can be used pretty much anywhere where fair could be put in. Only it has the added connotation off being honest as well as fair.
